id.description: Unique identifier for the Dispensary entity. Should match the vendor's UID.

vendorId.description: The UID of the vendor who owns this dispensary.

suburb.description: Suburb where the dispensary is located.

city.description: City where the dispensary is located.

state.description: State where the dispensary is located.

hours.description: Array of opening hours for each day.

categoryIds.description: References to Categories. (Relationship: Category N:N Dispensary)

isFeatured.description: Indicates if the dispensary is featured.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a category of cannabis products or dispensaries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

createdAt.description: The date and time the user account was created.

city.description: City where the user is located.

state.description: State where the user is located.

fcmTokens.description: Array of Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens for push notifications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Driver entity, matches the user's UID.

userId.description: The UID of the user with the 'driver' role.

vehicleDetails.description: Description of the driver's vehicle (e.g., 'White Toyota Corolla - ABC 123 GP').

availabilityStatus.description: The current status of the driver.

city.description: The city the driver operates in.

state.description: The state or province the driver operates in.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product sold by a dispensary.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

slug.description: URL-friendly version of the product name.

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

thc.description: The THC percentage of the product.

cbd.description: The CBD percentage of the product.

price.description: The price of the product. Used for non-flower, non-edible types.

weight.description: The weight of the product (e.g., '3.5g', '1oz'). Used for non-flower, non-edible types.

pricing.description: Array of pricing tiers for Flower products based on weight.

ediblePricing.description: Array of pricing tiers for Edible products based on strength.

sodaPricing.description: Array of pricing tiers for Soda products based on flavour.

createdAt.description: The date and time the product was added.

imageUrl.description: URL of the product's main image.

additionalImageUrls.description: An array of URLs for additional product images.

stock.description: The amount of product in stock for non-tiered products.

effectsLength.description: The duration of the edible's effects (e.g. '1-2 hours').

benefits.description: The potential benefits of the edible (e.g. 'Pain relief').

ingredients.description: A list of ingredients in the edible.

salePrice.description: The discounted price of the product.

isHotDeal.description: Indicates if the deal is a special 'hot deal' featured by admins.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer order from a dispensary.

dispensaryId.description: The ID of the dispensary the order is for.

customerId.description: The UID of the customer who placed the order.

driverId.description: The UID of the driver assigned to the delivery.

items.description: The items included in the order.

subtotal.description: The cost of items before taxes, fees, and commission.

vendorPayout.description: The final amount paid to the vendor (subtotal - commission).

total.description: The total amount paid by the customer (subtotal + taxes + deliveryFee).

confirmedAt.description: Timestamp for when the vendor confirms the order.

pickedUpAt.description: Timestamp for when the driver accepts the delivery.

completedAt.description: Timestamp for when the driver completes the delivery.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership ensures that only the user can access their data.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores a copy of an order for a specific user. Owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/dispensaries/{dispensary.description: Stores a private copy of dispensary information for a specific vendor. Write access is restricted to the owning vendor.

/drivers/{driverId}.description: Stores public information about a delivery driver.

/dispensaries/{dispensaryId}.description: Stores public dispensary information. Assumes public read access, but write access is restricted to the owning vendor.

/dispensaries/{dispensaryId}/products/{p.description: Stores products for a specific dispensary. Publicly readable, but write access is restricted to the owning vendor.

/dispensaries/{dispensaryId}/orders/{ord.description: Stores orders for a specific dispensary. Write access for customers, read access for the owning vendor.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Stores categories for dispensaries. Assumes public read access.
